payload.reason: the section chosen as drop-oldest carries the MAXIMUM non-sentinel timestamp key found anywhere in this file -- every dated section present (one, or several tied at an identical key) shares that same value, so ranking it as 'oldest' is not backed by any within-file ordering evidence and may be dropping the NEWEST real content instead (AC-6, FIX-NOTEBOOK-AUTOPRUNE-ROLLING-SECTIONS-BYTE-COUNTED-BUT-UNDROPPABLE occurrence 5).
